d.ko: Fire up the forge and craft your finest weapons in Jacksmith: Weapons and Warriors, a reforged adventure!  Equip the local warriors with custom swords, bows, shields and more in your hands-on blacksmith shop.  Follow the soldiers into battle as you push onward toward the evil wizard Dudley!
